# Paṭisambhidākathā (Kv 5.5)

**ID:** Kv 5.5
**Section:** Kathāvatthu (kv)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Paṭisambhidākathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m3.mul12.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Paṭisambhidākathā* (Kv 5.5) is a debate located in the fifth chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the canonical Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. The title of the text pertains to the doctrinal category of the analytical knowledges or discriminations (*paṭisambhidā*). Modern scholars note that the fourfold classification of *paṭisambhidā* (Sanskrit *pratisamvid*)—consisting of discrimination of meaning (*attha*), teachings or phenomena (*dhamma*), language (*nirutti*), and perspicuity (*paṭibhāna*)—is virtually absent from the earlier strata of the Pali sūtras, finding systematic treatment only in later canonical and Abhidhamma texts such as the *Kathāvatthu*, *Vibhaṅga*, and *Niddesa* [Potter 1996].

**Sources**
